prerequisites: Active participation in the practical course

learning_outcomes.text: Students possess basic knowledge for integral automation projects on processes by combining classic measurement, control, and regulation technology, information and communication technology in operation, and human-machine system technology.
After successful completion of the module, students are able to organize themselves into teams for division of labor to carry out practical experiments.
After successful completion of the module, students are able to apply personal competences for communication, problem-solving, and decision-making.

syllabus_topics: Information network and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)
Process control technology in the company's information flow
Automation pyramid (ERP, MES, SCADA Network, PLC, Sensors & Actuators)
Functions of integrated operational control technology
Functions of the process control level
Control Performance Monitoring (CPM) for process supervision
Devices of the process control level
Conventional signal transmission (current signals, NAMUR, voltage signals)
Integration of intelligent field devices into a process control system
Strain gauges (DMS) for measuring mechanical quantities
CAE systems for planning control technology facilities
Understanding and implementing simple experimental setups; logging and evaluating measurements
Practicing appropriate communication among each other, compiling and presenting work results
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded for a passed written examination. Active participation in the practical course is a prerequisite for taking the examination.
